translations.web: If anyone says anything to you, you shall say, ‘The Lord needs them,’ and immediately he will send them.”
translations.bsb: If anyone questions you, tell him that the Lord needs them, and he will send them right away.”
translations.kjv: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.
translations.asv: And if any one say aught unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.
